_comment: Topology of the issue lifecycle axis: every node, the schema each edge carries, gates, failure policy and width budget. scripts/validate-workflow-graph.ts enforces it; see docs/adr/0003-workflow-graph-contract.md. runtime: conversational = needs mid-run human interaction, stays in the main agent; workflow = graphable island runnable as a Workflow script; chain = sequential and deliberately not a graph. Every registry entry carries its JSON Schema body: it is what `agent({schema})` enforces at runtime, what the markdown renderer builds the skill templates from, and it is self-contained (a $ref may only point into the entry's own $defs) because workflow scripts must inline it verbatim as `const SCHEMA_<Name> = {...}`, which is what the drift check reads. A workflow node whose island is built carries `script`: the repo-relative workflows/*.js file realising it (two sibling nodes may share one script — one island runs both). The binding arms the drift check in the omission direction: every schema in the node's `out` must be inlined in that script (rule 17) and each inline body must be a strict-JSON literal deep-equal to the registry body (rule 18). Inputs are deliberately exempt — they arrive through `args`, validated by their producer. A workflow node without `script` is an island not yet built. Irreversible actions on the axis are inventoried as `irreversible: true`: issue-write (creates the Linear issue), implement (pushes commits), close (merges the PR/MR and sets Done), wiki-write (writes the nerdbrain vault); each must sit behind a gate (rule 6). Gates carry the role split as data: a `decision` gate is the human's call — mechanism `linear-status` or `chat-approval`, the Linear status being the only carrier of acceptance — while a `deny` gate is a hard prohibition that never asks, mechanism `pretooluse-hook` or `settings-deny`; the kind-mechanism pairing is a closed vocabulary (rule 19), so a new enforcement mechanism must change this contract deliberately. `frozenRules` is the first-class registry of frozen rules: a gate's `rule` points into it (rule 20), a deny gate exists only to enforce one (rule 21), and a rule no gate points to is rejected (rule 22). Human gates sit on the boundaries between workflows, never inside them — the runtime takes no mid-run decision input (rule 8).

frozenRules.rule: Nothing is written to Linear before the user approves the drafted issue in chat.
No repo change — edit, build, install, commit, PR — before the issue is In Progress, a status only the human sets.
No merge without green verification: tests and validators pass before close runs.
No vault access other than filesystem Read/Edit/Write and rg — never a Linear or Obsidian MCP, never the Local REST API.

schemas.description: The filed issue: objective, scope, acceptance criteria, constraints.

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: One or two sentences: the outcome we want and for whom. Testable, not a task list.

problemAndContext.title: Problem & context
problemAndContext.description: Why now? What's broken / missing / requested. Link related issues or docs.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Acceptance criteria
acceptanceCriteria.description: Each item independently verifiable. This is what "done" means.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Both halves matter: the out list is what stops the issue growing during planning.

outOfScope.title: Out of scope
outOfScope.description: What it deliberately leaves to another issue.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Tech constraints, non-functional requirements, deadlines, compatibility. Omit if none.

dependencies.title: Dependencies / related
dependencies.description: Blocking issues, external prerequisites, related TEAM-123 ids. Omit if none.

implementationChecklist.title: Implementation checklist
implementationChecklist.description: Use ONLY when the work is one deliverable with clear steps and is NOT split into sub-issues. If split into sub-issues, drop this section.

openQuestions.title: Open questions
openQuestions.description: Anything still ambiguous the planner/implementer must resolve. Omit if none.

schemas.description: Vault recall for the project: entity page sections, decisions, 1-hop graph.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Slug of the entity page the SessionStart hook injected.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Recorded project decisions the plan must not contradict without flagging it.

activeContext.title: Active context
activeContext.description: What the entity page says is currently in flight.

relatedPages.title: Related pages
relatedPages.description: One hop out: pages linked from the entity page or linking back to it.

schemas.description: The in-repo half of the plan context, gathered in parallel: repo layout, prior plans, related issues, ADRs. The vault half travels separately as ProjectContext, because a node belongs to exactly one skill.

repoLayout.title: Repo layout
repoLayout.description: The directories and files the change will touch.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.description: In-repo rules the plan must follow: CONTEXT.md terms, ADRs, commit style.

priorArt.title: Prior art
priorArt.description: Earlier plans, related issues and merged PRs worth reading before drafting.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Test, build and validator commands the plan will cite.

stats.title: Fan-out stats
stats.description: Passive observability of the fan-out, counted by the reducer from what the run already produced. Optional: absent whenever the context was gathered sequentially instead of as an island.

gatherers.title: Per gatherer
gatherers.description: One row per gatherer the island spawns, in its fixed spawn order — a failed gatherer stays in the list with zeros rather than vanishing.

items.title: Gatherer stats
items.description: What one gatherer contributed to the reduced context.

source.title: Source
source.description: The gatherer this row counts, e.g. `conventions`.

returned.title: Returned
returned.description: Non-empty list items the gatherer returned, before reduction.

unique.title: Unique
unique.description: Items it was the first to contribute that survived into the reduced context. A gatherer at zero across successive runs is a removal candidate.

duplicatesDropped.title: Duplicates dropped
duplicatesDropped.description: Returned items the reducer discarded as duplicates or past a recall limit — the fan-out's redundancy.

gapsCount.title: Gaps
gapsCount.description: Gaps the run reported: the node-failure count for this island.

schemas.description: The plan posted to Linear as a `## Implementation plan` comment.

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: One paragraph: what problem we solve and for whom.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Both halves matter: the out list is what stops the work growing mid-implementation.

outOfScope.title: Out of scope
outOfScope.description: What it deliberately leaves to another issue.

technicalApproach.title: Technical Approach
technicalApproach.description: Architecture / strategy, and why this one over the alternatives.

implementationSteps.title: Implementation Steps
implementationSteps.description: Ordered steps, each one an atomic commit.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Acceptance Criteria
acceptanceCriteria.description: Each item independently verifiable — this is what closes the issue.

risks.title: Risks
risks.description: One row per risk, each with the mitigation that keeps it survivable.

mitigation.title: Mitigation
mitigation.description: What keeps it from sinking the work.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Blocking issues, tooling and prerequisites outside this plan.

schemas.description: Commits pushed to the issue branch plus the draft PR that tracks them.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: The issue branch the commits landed on.

commits.title: Commits
commits.description: One line per commit, in the order they were pushed.

pullRequest.title: Pull request
pullRequest.description: URL of the draft PR carrying the Linear magic word.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Commands run against the change and what they reported.

schemas.description: The review request confirmed in review-menu: the four fixed axes, each with the engine detected for it, plus the change range to read. Only review-menu sees the session's skill list, so engine detection happens there, never inside the island.

axes.title: Axes
axes.description: All four review axes, always present — a missing engine degrades an axis to plain-agent, never removes it.

items.title: Axis
items.description: One review axis and the engine driving it.

id.title: Axis id
id.description: Which of the four fixed, mutually independent review axes this is.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: The review path driving this axis — a prompt hint for the mapper, not a hard invocation. A free string, so a new engine never forces a contract bump; the island degrades unknown values to plain-agent.

range.title: Change range
range.description: The diff range to read, e.g. `main...HEAD`.

schemas.description: Verified findings plus the stats that make degradation visible. Every finding survived adversarial verification: 3 independent sceptics each try to refute it, and 2 or more refutations out of 3 reject it; rejected findings never reach this payload, but their count does. A single finding never travels an edge on its own, so ReviewFinding lives as a `$defs` inside this entry.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One paragraph: what the review covered and whether the change is ready.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: One row per finding that survived verification.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Degradation made visible: what each stage let through, so a silent drop is impossible.

mapped.title: Mapped
mapped.description: Raw findings the axis mappers returned, before reduction.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Findings refuted by 2 or more of the 3 sceptics.

unverifiedOverflow.title: Unverified overflow
unverifiedOverflow.description: Findings that never got a verdict: past the verification cap, or with fewer than 2 votes cast.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The review axis that raised the finding.

file.title: File
file.description: Repo-relative path the finding sits in.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Concrete inputs or state that make the claim fail — what makes it checkable.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: How much damage it does if left in.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the verification pass is that the finding is real.

schemas.description: The `## Session summary` comment: what changed, what remains, validation, next steps.

changed.title: What changed
changed.description: Files and areas touched in this session.

remaining.title: Scope remaining
remaining.description: What is still open, so the next session can resume from Linear alone.

status.title: Current status
status.description: Where the work stands and what the issue status is.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Commands run and what they reported — evidence, not assertions.

nextSteps.title: Open questions / next steps
nextSteps.description: What the next session should pick up, and what is still undecided.

schemas.description: The merged PR/MR, the checkout switched to the base branch, the issue set to Done.

pullRequest.title: Pull request
pullRequest.description: The merged PR/MR and the commit it landed as.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The branch the local checkout switched to after the merge.

issueState.title: Issue state
issueState.description: The Linear state the issue was left in.

schemas.description: The entity page edit plus the index/log upkeep that goes with it.

page.title: Page
page.description: Vault path of the entity page that was written.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Which sections were edited or appended, and in which mode.

upkeep.title: Index and log upkeep
upkeep.description: The `index.md` / `log.md` lines added alongside the page edit.

gates.description: The user approves the drafted issue before anything is written to Linear.

failure.fallback: continue without vault context and flag the gap in the plan
degrade to the sequential context read in the main agent

gates.description: The human sets the issue to In Progress in Linear; no repo change happens before that.

failure.fallback: fall back to the user reviewing the PR manually

gates.description: The user confirms the axis set and the detected engines; the runtime takes no mid-run input, so this cannot move inside review-verify.

failure.fallback: report partial findings and mark the run incomplete
stop and report (merge conflict, missing gh/glab)

gates.description: The human asks to close, or sets the issue to Done with the PR still open; the merge is irreversible.

failure.fallback: skip the wiki write and report it to the user

gates.description: Vault access is filesystem-only; the Obsidian/Linear MCP and the Local REST API are denied in settings.json — a hard stop, never a question.
